module_summary: PS/2 message-boundary detector: a 4-state Moore FSM tracks bytes 1-3 using in[3] as the sync bit and decodes done.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Tracks BYTE1/BYTE2/BYTE3/DONE position within the three-byte message stream.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Decoded from DONE state; signals a full three-byte message was received.

groups.name: byte_tracker_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic on in[3] advances byte position; done decoded from DONE state.
